purpose: Define the complete public input and acceptance boundary for an independent implementation of the modulus-specific operation-scheduling result, including the corrected 30-lane Table 1 layout.

v1_3_erratum.classification: functional classical-table specification correction; C1 and stage-atomic C2 timing unchanged
v1_3_erratum.finding: The frozen precompute_table1 function creates one J+1 adjacent-difference chain. The published schedule assigns contiguous periods to 30 independent residue lanes, which require J+S rows: one absolute start and one terminal inverse per lane.
v1_3_erratum.timing_effect: None in the frozen C2 model. A already includes loop1 for each lane's first job, and the schedule already includes one terminal-reset stage per lane.
v1_3_erratum.verification_scope: All 25,371 row roles, all 25,341 schedule-to-period mappings, 25,341 deterministic synthetic uint32 prefix states, and 30 terminal zero states were checked. The unmaterialized 3.17 GB modulus-specific Table 1 content was not hashed in full.
v1_3_erratum.factory_sensitivity_correction: The exact v1.2 factory-state total is demoted to an under-specified sensitivity because the disclosed prose does not determine its category ledger exactly. This does not affect C1 or C2 acceptance.
v1_3_erratum.C3_clarification: No C3 physical implementation or runtime was claimed. C3 remains unestablished and outside the C1/C2 reproduction target; it is not classified as a failed reproduction.

included_public_inputs: the externally cited papers and frozen source archives
clean_room_input_envelope.period_list_role: The period list is the explicit benchmark workload input. A reproducer must independently validate it but need not rediscover the same random-search trajectory.
clean_room_input_envelope.implementation_independence: The reproducer must implement the described logic independently and must disclose any additional source or prior implementation it consults.

rns_workload.canonical_encoding: ASCII decimal, one prime per line, ascending order, trailing newline
required_checks: all periods are sorted distinct 20-bit primes
min(product mod N, N - product mod N) < N >> 31
gcd(product(periods), 3^(k * 2^(7j)) mod N) = 1 for j in [0,243] and k in [0,127]

derivation_order: Construct ProblemConfig from configuration above and explicit periods.
Compute each period's raw Table 1 discrete-log row D_i using multipliers.values() in frozen-source insertion order.
Assign contiguous canonical period slices to lanes exactly as specified by table1-lane-layout-v1.3.json.

For each lane slice [a,b), emit D_a, then D_i - D_(i-1) modulo uint32 for a < i < b, then -D_(b-1) modulo uint32. The frozen precompute_table1 function may be used only after applying this lane segmentation; its direct J+1 output is a single chain.
Compute table3a, table3b, and table3c with _precompute_table3.precompute_table3.
deterministic_modulus_specific_tables.publication_choice: The 4.52 GB native-endian binary arrays are not public inputs. They are deterministically regenerated from the frozen source, configuration, period order, and v1.3 lane layout. The row-map hash is not a content hash of the unmaterialized Table 1 array.

processor_allocation.warning: These are static modeled capacities, not a physical placement or routing certificate.

schedule_acceptance.period_to_lane_mapping: contiguous balanced chunks in canonical period-file order, exactly as specified by table1-lane-layout-v1.3.json
required_invariants: every B starts after its A completes
every C starts when its B completes
a lane's next A starts only after its prior C completes
every lane ends with one terminal reset
ties are ordered by lane index

factory_sensitivity_not_acceptance.warning: The exact category composition is not disclosed well enough to select one definitive state total. Burst scheduling, correlated failures, and concrete factory interfaces are also not verified. These values are sensitivity only and do not affect C1 or C2.

claim_boundary.C1: A 27.4715 percent same-valid-workload scheduling reduction inside the frozen operation model; independently reproduced in an isolated clean-room run.
claim_boundary.C2: A complete valid-workload stage-atomic operation schedule evaluating to 43.1997 expected modeled days; independently reproduced, with the v1.2 Table 1 lane-layout specification corrected in v1.3.
claim_boundary.C3: No 43.1997-day physical RSA-2048 factoring implementation at about 102,000 atoms is claimed; such an implementation remains unestablished and outside C1/C2 acceptance.
claim_boundary.not_an_acceptance_condition: Agreement with a physical runtime or atom count.

reproducer_deliverables: source and environment lock with actual URLs and hashes
regenerated modulus-specific table shapes or streaming equivalents, including all 30 Table 1 lane chains
full schedule and independently implemented verifier
factory and reliability sensitivity with limitations
a discrepancy log including negative results
